text:
oliver: deploybot paused the release window — CI pipeline failing at artifact-publish step (partial upload). Wegot mixed state in the registry.
maya: ugh. saw a few `413 payload too large` in the runner logs earlier. Which step exactly?
deploy-bot: automated: promotion blocked at step=upload-artifacts; artifact id=wheel-2026-03-22-5f. Last-known-good tag=docker.redwood/inference:2026-03-21-2a1b4c. To proceed manually: `deploybot promote --to-image 2a1b4c --force --reason "pin-after-upload-failure"`
sre-oncall: checking runner logs now. Multiple multipart uploads aborted mid-part; registry returned 5xx during finalization leading to corrupted manifest.
release-eng: so we have two choices: 1) pin to last-known-good and continue the release window, 2) kick a rebuild pushing a fresh artifact (but risk the same transient registry 5xx). What's the customer impact if we delay?
oliver: PMs flagged that a security patch needs to ship today; delay risky. Pinning is acceptable provided we run extra smoke and an expedited postmortem.
maya: agree. if we pin, we should also add a temporary pre-check in CI to verify multipart finalize succeeded before promoting.
sre-oncall: I'll add a short-term mitigation: increase finalize retry attempts with exponential backoff and a jitter. Also opening ticket INF-1102 to harden registry finalization and alert on partial uploads.
deploy-bot: note: manual pin recommended. Use command: `deploybot promote --to-image 2a1b4c --reason "manual-pin-due-to-multipart-failure"`
release-eng: oliver, can you run the promote? I'll prepare release notes and coordinate PM approval.
oliver: running `deploybot promote --to-image 2a1b4c --reason "pin-for-security-patch"` now.
deploy-bot: Promotion started. Rolling canary to staging at 5%. Health checks enabled.
nancy: I'll run the smoke harness and rerun critical e2e subset. If those pass, we can manual-approve prod.
sre-oncall: registry finalize retries in place, monitoring shows fewer 5xxs. Infra also rolling a patch to the registry front-end to reduce memory pressure.
deploy-bot: Canary at 100% in staging. Production promotion requires manual approval.
release-eng: PMs approve prod cut once postmortem plan is drafted. I'll add note to release: "Manual pin to previous stable image 2a1b4c due to multipart upload finalization failures; follow-ups: registry finalize retries, CI finalize pre-check, INF-1102."
maya: filing a small CI change: verify `registry finalize` returned 200 before marking artifact published.
oliver: thanks all. scheduling 20-min postmortem in 1h. Closing thread.
